outcome: interventional treatment failure for intractable postpartum hemorrhage (IPH)
cohort: The study included 64 patients with intractable postpartum hemorrhage (IPH) who received interventional treatment at First Hospital of Shanxi Medical University between January 2012 and September 2014.
finding: History of uterine scar and combined use of uterotonics were identified as risk factors for interventional treatment failure of intractable postpartum hemorrhage (IPH).
